cases.name: testAlignAcrossCommentsAndEmptyLines
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    " test alignment across comments and empty lines (depending on configuration):
    ls_struc-component += 1.
    " comment
    ls_struc-comp2 = 'a'.

    ls_struc-c3 = VALUE #( ).

    " comment
    ls_struc-comp4 -= 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    " test alignment across comments and empty lines (depending on configuration):
    ls_struc-component += 1.
    " comment
    ls_struc-comp2      = 'a'.

    ls_struc-c3         = VALUE #( ).

    " comment
    ls_struc-comp4     -= 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testDynamicComponents
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
  ls_struc-comp = 'a'.
  ls_struc-('COMP') = 'b'.
  ls_struc-(lv_comp_name) = 'c'.

  <ls_struc>-comp = 'd'.
  <ls_struc>-('COMP') = 'e'.
  <ls_struc>-(lv_comp_name) = 'f'.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
  ls_struc-comp           = 'a'.
  ls_struc-('COMP')       = 'b'.
  ls_struc-(lv_comp_name) = 'c'.

  <ls_struc>-comp           = 'd'.
  <ls_struc>-('COMP')       = 'e'.
  <ls_struc>-(lv_comp_name) = 'f'.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testDynamicComponentsWithComments
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
  ls_struc-comp " comment1
  = 'a'.
  ls_struc-('COMP') = " comment2
  'b'.
  ls_struc-(lv_comp) = 'c'. " comment3

  <ls_struc>-comp " comment1
  = 'a'.
  <ls_struc>-('COMP') = " comment2
  'b'.
  <ls_struc>-(lv_comp) = 'c'. " comment3
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
  ls_struc-comp " comment1
                     = 'a'.
  ls_struc-('COMP')  = " comment2
                       'b'.
  ls_struc-(lv_comp) = 'c'. " comment3

  <ls_struc>-comp " comment1
                       = 'a'.
  <ls_struc>-('COMP')  = " comment2
                         'b'.
  <ls_struc>-(lv_comp) = 'c'. " comment3
  ENDMETHOD.
